escenas.texto: Over two hundred and seventeen million views in a single week. Thirty videos. And at the top of Africa, a creator with fewer than twenty thousand subscribers who beat channels with more than ten million. Who? You'll find out at the right moment. This is Top 10 Social Media, the Africa edition. Three countdowns: the most viewed, the most commented and the most liked videos of the week. Real numbers, from ten to one. Let's go.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured at this week's cut-off. No guesses. Just data.

Countdown number one: the ten most viewed. Opening the list at number ten, from Egypt, HimaVibes Art, with a fifty-six second drawing Short. Over five point two million views and over one hundred and seven thousand likes.
Number nine, Asmaa Mohamed, a channel with four point seven million subscribers. A three minute video with over five point four million views and over three thousand one hundred comments.

At number eight, Bilal Al-Khader. A twenty-five second Short, over eight point one million views, from a channel with about fifty-six thousand subscribers. Remember that pattern. Small channels are going to dominate tonight.

Number seven, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over eight point three million views, from a channel with about seventy-seven thousand subscribers. Keep this name in mind. It's coming back.
At number six, from Egypt, Abdelrahman El Desoky, a channel with ten point nine million subscribers. A one minute video, over eight point eight million views.

Number five, football. Mr Cristiano, with a Short about PSG four, Barcelona two, in the Champions League. Over nine point three million views, for a thirty-two second Short from a channel of about fifty-four thousand subscribers.
At number four, Ali w Rehab, a channel with two point two million subscribers. A one minute video with over eleven million views. And now, the podium.

Bronze medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Ten seconds long, over twelve million views and over three hundred and seven thousand likes. Eleven point six million subscribers. The biggest channel on this podium, and it's only bronze.

Silver medal, MathMango, with “How Many Folds To Reach The Moon?”. Over fourteen million views for a thirty-one second Short. The channel? About seventeen thousand subscribers. And yet, someone beat it.

Here it is. Number one most viewed in Africa: from Egypt, elbezawy. A sixteen second Short with over seventeen million views, from a channel of about nineteen thousand subscribers. And the twist: only forty-six comments. Seventeen million people watched, and almost nobody said a word.
From silence, to noise. Countdown number two: the ten most commented. Number ten, from Egypt, HikaSIU, with a twenty-two minute video. Over one thousand four hundred comments.
Number nine, from Morocco, Mehdi Hilm, with a twelve minute eFootball video. Over one thousand seven hundred comments, with only over eighty-eight thousand views. A small audience that talks a lot.
At number eight, MathMango again, with the folds to the Moon. Over one thousand nine hundred comments. Silver in views, and now in the conversation too.
Number seven, Zack D. Films, a channel with twenty-nine point four million subscribers, with “How Banks Make Money With Your Savings”. Over two thousand one hundred comments.
At number six, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over two thousand three hundred comments. I told you this name would come back.
Number five, from Egypt, minaashraf, with a one minute video. Over two thousand five hundred comments, and over two point four million views.
At number four, Asmaa Mohamed, again. Over three thousand one hundred comments. And from here, the conversation heats up.
Bronze medal in comments, from Tunisia, Ury 2, with a nine minute video. Over three thousand seven hundred comments, from a channel of about eighty-four thousand subscribers.
Silver medal, AJ+ Kabreet, with a forty-six minute episode. Over four thousand three hundred comments, and over three point nine million views. Forty-six minutes, and people still had more to say.

Number one most commented in Africa: from Egypt, Abdullah Elshrif, with a nineteen minute episode. Over six thousand one hundred comments, and over two point three million views. The loudest comment section on the continent this week.
And the final countdown: the ten most liked. At number ten, from Egypt, minaashraf. Over ninety-six thousand likes.
Number nine, from Egypt, HimaVibes Art, with the drawing Short. Over one hundred and seven thousand likes.
At number eight, from Egypt, Abdelrahman El Desoky. Over one hundred and eighteen thousand likes.
Number seven, Asmaa Mohamed. Over one hundred and forty-one thousand likes. Asmaa Mohamed appears on all three lists tonight.
At number six, Ali w Rehab. Over one hundred and eighty-two thousand likes.
Number five, MathMango. Over one hundred and eighty-six thousand likes. Seventeen thousand subscribers, and present on all three countdowns.
At number four, Zack D. Films, with the bank savings Short. Over two hundred and twenty-eight thousand likes. And now, the final podium of the night.
Bronze medal in likes, Khaled Pepo, with a one minute video. Over two hundred and ninety-two thousand likes, and over five point one million views.
Silver medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Over three hundred and seven thousand likes. Bronze in views, silver in likes. But number one is a name you already know.

Number one most liked in Africa: SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over three hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes, on over eight point three million views, from a channel of about seventy-seven thousand subscribers. Seventh in views, sixth in comments, and first in the hearts of the audience.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Europe. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
